descriptions.w3d_s20_make_message_800fb9e0: Appears to allocate an 8-byte message from a global pool, store the id copied from the argument and a table pointer, and return it.
descriptions.w3d_s20_unregister_801655b0: Appears to run a base cleanup, unregister this subobject from a global list and decrement a 16-bit count.
descriptions.w3d_s20_unregister_8017b7e8: Appears to run a base cleanup, unregister this subobject from a global list and decrement a 16-bit count.
descriptions.w3d_s20_select_entry_8016a570: Appears to pass zero or the table entry selected by an item field to a helper and return zero.
descriptions.w3d_s20_set_record_flag_80199fa4: Appears to find a record by key and set its flag bit to the given value, returning 1 when found.
descriptions.w3d_s20_construct_pair_801bc394: Appears to run a base constructor, clear two words and install a vtable pointer, returning this.
